properties.statement: Carried a design's open questions by hand between two agents. A designer agent worked the design, and a separate owner agent with no design tools decided. Each round, the hub session copied the designer's numbered question batch into a message to the owner, then copied the owner's numbered answers back. The designer kept its own question-number → node map in a scratch file so the answers could be recorded against the right nodes. Three rounds and about 20 questions.
